description: Add candidates through multiple sources: manual entry form, LinkedIn profile URL scraping via Apify, or PDF resume upload. Automatically extracts structured candidate data including personal information, skills with proficiency levels, and years of experience using AI parsing.

Create job records with structured data extraction from client notes. Uses AI to parse unstructured text and generate job attributes (rate, location, commitment) and weighted requirements with proficiency levels for accurate candidate matching.

Manage company database with industry classification, location, website, and culture information. Provides dropdown selection during job creation and maintains consistent company data across the platform for better reporting and organization.

Generate polished job descriptions from structured job data and requirements. Creates professional, formatted job postings optimized for candidate attraction using AI content generation based on company culture, role requirements, and market standards.

Generate Boolean search strings for LinkedIn Recruiter and Sales Navigator. Creates multiple query variations (complete, skills-only, job-titles-only, mandatory-only) with search recommendations to optimize candidate sourcing and discovery.

Unified AI-powered candidate-job compatibility analysis with additive scoring system (no penalties for optional requirements). Features unified architecture across three specialized APIs (LinkedIn profiles, PDF resumes, existing candidates), intelligent skill hierarchy recognition with aliases, 3-tier proficiency mapping (beginner/advanced/expert), 4-category scoring (strong/adequate/weak/missing), evidence-based confidence tracking, and comprehensive narrative generation with recruiter recommendations and interview strategies.

Generate tailored interview questions based on job requirements and descriptions. Creates structured questions across six categories (technical, problem-solving, communication, leadership, learning, cultural) with exactly two questions per category for comprehensive candidate evaluation.

Create personalized recruitment emails for candidates and clients. Supports multiple email types (outreach, follow-up, scheduling) with AI-generated content using job context, candidate information, and sender details for professional communication.

Record and analyze Google Meet interviews using Recall.ai bot integration. Provides real-time transcription, AI-powered interview analysis, scoring across competency areas, and actionable insights for data-driven hiring decisions.
